name: La Crema
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (lacrema.com) Sonoma Coast Chardonnay from La Crema. Known for quality California Chardonnay since 1979. Balanced, approachable style. Also available by the glass!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied Chardonnay | Apple, pear & vanilla | Balanced oak, food-friendly | Classic California elegance.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Lobster, scallops, chicken, cream sauces, seafood.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Versatile Chardonnay for diverse menus. Available by the glass too!

name: Knights Bridge "KB"
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (knightsbridgewinery.com) 'KB' Chardonnay from Knights Bridge in Knights Valley, Napa. Estate fruit, Burgundian style. Premium Napa quality!

🍷 STYLE: Medium to full-bodied Chardonnay | Ripe apple, citrus & subtle oak | Balanced, elegant | Napa with Burgundy influence.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Lobster, scallops, roasted chicken, cream sauces.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Premium Napa Chardonnay with Burgundian elegance. Knights Valley terroir!

name: Rombauer
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (rombauer.com) Iconic Carneros Chardonnay from Rombauer Vineyards. Rich, buttery California style. One of America's most beloved Chardonnays!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Chardonnay | Rich butter, vanilla & tropical fruit | Creamy texture | Classic Carneros character | Rombauer signature.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Lobster, crab, roasted chicken, cream sauces.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Iconic California Chardonnay. Consistently one of America's favorites!

name: Shafer "Red Shoulder Ranch"
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (shafervineyards.com) 'Red Shoulder Ranch' Chardonnay from Shafer's Carneros vineyard. Cool-climate elegance from legendary Napa producer. Highly acclaimed!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Chardonnay | Ripe apple, citrus & oak | Complex, balanced | Carneros cool-climate | Age-worthy quality.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Lobster, scallops, roasted chicken, fine cuisine.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Premium Carneros Chardonnay from legendary Shafer. Collector quality!

name: Wayfarer
serverNotes:
ABOUT: (pahlmeyer.com) Wayfarer Chardonnay from Pahlmeyer's Fort Ross-Seaview estate. Extreme coastal Sonoma. World-class cool-climate Chardonnay!

 STYLE: Full-bodied Chardonnay | Precise citrus, mineral & complexity | Coastal elegance | Burgundian finesse | Investment-grade.

 PAIRS WITH: Oysters, lobster, fine seafood, special celebrations.

 BOTTLE SERVICE: Ultra-premium coastal Chardonnay. Pahlmeyer excellence meets Burgundy!

name: Aubert "UV-SL"
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Single-vineyard Sonoma Coast Chardonnay from Aubert, rated 97 by Vinous. A cult California white.

🍷 STYLE: Rich but precise Chardonnay | Lemon curd, yellow apple, hazelnut & toasted oak | Creamy texture with bright acidity | Very long finish

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Lobster risotto, seared sea scallops, lobster stuffed shells, chicken piccata, Alfredo.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: A strong bottle to suggest for the table; check the vintage on the list when presenting.
